title: Minimal free model over a local ring
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m,\kappa)$ be a local ring and let $K\in D(R)$ [def-pc-derived-category] be pseudo-coherent [def-pur-pseudo-coherent-complex]. Put $d_i=\dim_\kappa H^i(K\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}\kappa)$. If the $d_i$ are finite and vanish for all sufficiently large $i$, then $K$ is represented by a bounded-above complex of finite free $R$-modules whose term in degree $i$ is $R^{\oplus d_i}$.
